etymology.hint: One person talking 可 over another 可

characterDeckComponents.note: 哥 doubles the character 可 ('to approve, to sing'), originally suggesting a call-and-response song between two singers; the meaning later narrowed to 'elder brother.'

makemeahanzi.definition: category, class, group, kind; similar to; to resemble

characterDeckComponents.note: 王 (jade, written as the radical for 玉) — 瑞 describes a jade tablet used as a token of good fortune.
耑 (duān) gives a sound distantly related to ruì, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: A person, crouched 尸 passing water 水

characterDeckComponents.note: A person's crouching body shape.
Water — represents the liquid being passed.

meanings: (bound form) secretion (of the ear, eye etc)

etymology.hint: A person, crouched 尸 defecating 米; 米 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 尸 depicts a person in a bent or crouching posture (the same component used for 'corpse' and other body-related characters).
The small dots resembling grains of rice (米) represent what is expelled — combined with the crouching figure, giving 屎 its meaning 'excrement.'
木 (wood) — 格 originally meant a wooden branch or standard, extended to 'pattern, style, rule.'
各 (gè) gives a sound hint — 格 is pronounced gé, sharing the same rhyme with a different tone.
A drawing of a left hand holding a tool, contrasted with 又, an early form of the right hand.

meanings: great number of people or things

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — 海 relates to bodies of water, specifically the sea.
每 (měi) gives a hint of the sound — 海 is pronounced hǎi, a connection that has shifted over time.

etymology.hint: To look someone in the eye 目

characterDeckComponents.note: 十 (here a straight vertical line) — 直 pictures something drawn perfectly straight.
目 (eye) — looking directly and steadily with the eye gave 直 its meaning 'straight' or 'direct.'

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 樂, a musical instrument with wood 木, strings 幺, and a pick 白

characterDeckComponents.note: 乐 is the simplified form of 樂, which depicted a wooden 木 instrument strung with strings 幺, played with a pick 白 — music came to represent joy, giving 乐 its meaning 'happy, music.'

meanings: (literary) the right side as the side of precedence

makemeahanzi.definition: to raise; to recommend; to praise

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 举 relates to lifting or raising something with the hand
舉 (jǔ) is the traditional character's own form, giving the sound directly, an exact match

etymology.hint: A woman 女 safe in a house 宀

characterDeckComponents.note: 宀 (a roof, house) — 安 pictures shelter.
女 (woman) — a woman safely inside a house gave 安 its meaning 'peace' or 'safety.'

etymology.hint: To skillfully wield 帀 a knife 刂

characterDeckComponents.note: 帀 (a banner or covering) — flying above the scene.
刂 (a knife) — wielded with skill beneath the banner, an image of expertise giving 师 its meaning 'master, teacher, expert.'

meanings: to leave behind or forget to bring

makemeahanzi.definition: to fall, to drop; surplus, net income

characterDeckComponents.note: 艹 (grass/plant) — 落 relates to leaves or plants falling
洛 (luò) gives the sound — 落 is also pronounced luò, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to copy, to record, to write down

etymology.hint: A brush used to record stories

characterDeckComponents.note: 录 traditionally depicted a hand-held tool used for carving or writing records — the image behind its meaning 'to record, to write down.'

etymology.hint: A hand 又 held up against a cliff 厂

characterDeckComponents.note: 厂 (a cliff or overhang) — 反 pictures pushing against a steep surface.
又 (a hand) — a hand pushing back against a cliff gave 反 its meaning 'to turn over' or 'opposite.'
王 (a variant form of 玉, meaning jade) — 理 originally referred to the natural grain or pattern in jade, later extending to 'reason, logic, to manage.'
里 (lǐ) gives the sound — 理 is also pronounced lǐ, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: tool, implement; to draw up, to write

etymology.hint: Two hands 八 writing on a tablet 目

characterDeckComponents.note: 八 (two hands) — holding something up.
目 (a container/tray) — held between the two hands, the image behind 具's meaning 'tool, utensil.'

meanings: to pile on top of one another

etymology.hint: Simplified form of 層; 曾 provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 层 depicts a roof-like covering stacked over what lies beneath, evoking one layer piled upon another.

etymology.hint: To dig out 扌 a hollow 穵; 穵 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — digging is done by hand or with a tool held by hand.
Represents a hollow or cave-like shape being dug out.

etymology.hint: A craftsman using an awl 弋 and a measuring square 工

characterDeckComponents.note: 弋 (an awl or tool) — one of the craftsman's instruments.
工 (a measuring square) — a tool for making things to a fixed pattern, giving 式 its meaning 'style, form, type.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to stop up, to seal, to cork, to block; pass, frontier; fortress

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (earth) — 塞 relates to blocking a gap or opening, as with packed earth.

meanings: to carry on a shoulder pole

makemeahanzi.definition: to select, to choose; picky, choosy; a load

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 挑 describes an action done with the hand, picking or carrying.
兆 (zhào) gives a sound distantly related to tiāo, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: (of chili pepper, raw onions etc) to sting

characterDeckComponents.note: 辛 (bitter/pungent) — 辣 describes a pungent, spicy taste.
束 (shù) gives a sound only distantly related to là today, having drifted apart over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to cut, to mince, to slice, to carve; close to; eager

characterDeckComponents.note: 刀 (knife) — relates directly to 切's meaning 'to cut.'
七 (qī) gives a sound hint — 切 is pronounced qiè, sharing the same initial consonant.

makemeahanzi.definition: to summon; to recruit; to levy

etymology.hint: A call 召 to arms 扌; 召 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — suggests a gesture, a beckoning motion.
召 depicts a call or summons — a hand gesture calling someone over gave 招 its meaning 'to beckon, to recruit.'

makemeahanzi.definition: to explode; to fry in oil; to scald

etymology.hint: A sudden 乍 flame 火; 乍 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 炸 relates to a sudden burst of fire, an explosion.
乍 depicts something happening abruptly — combined with fire, giving 炸 its meaning 'to explode, to deep-fry.'
土 (earth) — 墙 names a structure traditionally built from packed earth or brick.
啬 (sè) gives a sound distantly related to qiáng, having drifted apart over time.

meanings: to banish or send into exile

makemeahanzi.definition: to flow, to drift, to circulate; class

characterDeckComponents.note: 氵 (water) — relates directly to 流's meaning 'to flow.'
㐬 (liú) gives the sound — 流 is also pronounced liú, an exact match.

makemeahanzi.definition: to attach, to build, to join

characterDeckComponents.note: Hand — putting things together by hand.
Gives the sound dá, related to dā but drifted apart over time.

meanings: fret on the neck of a pipa 琵琶[pi2 pa5]

etymology.hint: To stare 目 at a tree 木, meaning to observe

characterDeckComponents.note: 木 (tree) — 相 pictures looking closely at a tree.
目 (eye) — staring closely at a tree to examine it gave 相 the meaning 'to observe' or, later, 'each other, mutual.'
木 (wood) — 权 originally meant a wooden lever or weight, later extended to 'power, authority, right.'
雚 was historically closer to guàn; the pronunciation has since shifted to quán, so the sound link is faint today.

makemeahanzi.definition: to upset, to capsize, to flip over

characterDeckComponents.note: 羽 (feather/wings) — flipping and turning relates to the flapping motion of wings.
番 (fān) gives the sound — an exact match with 翻's reading fān.

meanings: hem (at the bottom of a garment)

makemeahanzi.definition: to arrange, to display; pendulum, swing

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 摆 describes placing or swinging something with the hand.
罢 (bà) gives a sound distantly related to bǎi, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Soil 土 crushed under pressure 厂

characterDeckComponents.note: 土 (soil) — earth being pressed down
厂 (a cliff/overhang) — a heavy mass bearing down from above

meanings: to warm oneself by a fire

makemeahanzi.definition: to bake, to cook, to roast, to toast

characterDeckComponents.note: 火 (fire) — 烤 describes cooking directly over fire or heat.
考 (kǎo) gives the sound — an exact match with 烤.
厂 (a cliff or overhang) — 原 relates to a source high up, such as a spring emerging from rock.
泉 (quán) gives a hint of the sound — 原 is pronounced yuán, a connection that has shifted somewhat.
火 (fire) — 灯 names a lamp, which once gave light through a small flame.
丁 (dīng) gives a sound distantly related to dēng, having drifted apart over time.

etymology.hint: Resembling 肖 grain 禾; 肖 also provides the pronunciation

characterDeckComponents.note: 禾 (grain) — 稍 relates to a small amount of grain.
肖 (to resemble) — grain 禾 that only resembles a full harvest, a slightly smaller amount, gave 稍 its meaning 'slightly, a little.'
亻 (person) — 仅 relates to a person or amount limited to just this much, giving its meaning 'only, merely'

meanings: (of a plant) to produce (fruit or seeds)

makemeahanzi.definition: knot, tie; to connect, to join

characterDeckComponents.note: 纟 (thread) — 结 relates to tying or knotting threads together.
吉 (jí) gives a hint of the sound — 结 is pronounced jié, a connection that has shifted over time.

makemeahanzi.definition: to rip, to tear; to haul; casual talk

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 扯 describes pulling or tearing something by hand.
止 (zhǐ) gives a sound distantly related to 扯's reading chě, having drifted apart over time.
艹 (grass/plant) — 蓝 originally named the indigo plant used to make blue dye.
监 (jiān) gives a sound distantly related to lán, having drifted apart over time.
土 (earth) — 型 originally related to a mold made of clay used for casting
刑 (xíng) gives the sound — 型 is also pronounced xíng, an exact match

makemeahanzi.definition: to raise one's voice; to yell, to shout; to stammer

characterDeckComponents.note: 口 (mouth) — 呐 relates to shouting.
内 (nèi) gives a sound related to 呐's reading nà, sharing the initial though the final has shifted.

makemeahanzi.definition: to announce, to report; newspaper; payback, revenge

etymology.hint: A hand 扌 cuffing 又 a criminal 卩, representing sentencing

characterDeckComponents.note: 扌 (hand) — 报 relates to taking action against someone.
卩 (a kneeling or bound person) — handling a wrongdoer and announcing the judgment gave 报 its meaning 'to report' or 'to announce.'
